=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2533-2544, scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2546-2567 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Merge-with-followup lineage extraction searches the raw parent issue body without filtering fenced or quoted content, allowing a declaration to override the verified PR base.
  WHY: The raw-body regex matches declarations in fenced content, and parent metadata takes priority over the PR-base fallback.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Fix every instance of each finding's defect class across this project's changes, not only the cited line: the re-audit checks sibling code paths (other venues, adapters, handlers, workers) for the same defect and re-opens the loop if any remain." The `validate-generated-issue-base-spoofing` finding covers branch declarations in diagnostic/quoted content being accepted as authorization. The reviewer-judge is one such sibling venue.
  Expected change site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2533-2544 and scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2555-2567 — the production code that extracts the `Integration branch:` and `Tracking issue:` lineage from the parent issue body for the follow-up, and the PR-base fallback that only fires when extraction returns empty. The fix must restrict extraction to the leading preamble or the unfenced, `---`-separated `**Orchestrator metadata** (do not edit)` footer, matching the parser hardening applied to scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh, scripts/orchestrate_lib.py, scripts/orchestrate_force_tick.sh, and .github/workflows/validate.yml in this PR; for an `orchestrator/project-<N>` PR base, mismatched parent branch or tracking number must not override the verified PR base, and `(default branch)` declarations must not suppress the fallback.
  Evidence of absence: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh is not in the PR changed files list (see PR CHANGED FILES section) and has no diff hunks; LAST RUN CHANGED FILES confirms scripts/review_rb_judge.sh was not modified in the most recent autofix attempt either. The 08056bd commit message explicitly claims "In scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2533-2575, extract both lineage fields only from authoritative parent metadata and, for an orchestrator/project-<N> PR base, reject mismatched parent branch or tracking number and derive lineage from that base instead" — but the change was never landed (the multiple "Editor changes lost" comments on the PR — entries[5], entry[7], entry[9] — confirm prior attempts failed to commit). The current code at scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2533-2544 passes the raw body to run_review_rb_validator_python -c with a regex that searches the full text (`body = sys.stdin.read()` then `re.search(..., body, re.MULTILINE)`), not a filtered authoritative subset. Lines 2546-2567 use parent metadata first and fall back to the PR base only when extraction returns empty. Three tests in tests/test_review_rb_judge_label_propagation.py now assert the unimplemented behavior (test_merge_with_followup_ignores_fenced_tracking_lineage at line 2506, test_merge_with_followup_parent_metadata_wins_over_pr_base_branch at line 2490, test_merge_with_followup_ignores_default_branch_sentinel at line 2462); all three would fail against the current production code, which extracts `#4001` from the fenced block and uses parent metadata over the PR base.
  severity=critical | confidence=5
